artworks.title: Unklug (Unwise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of three separate scenes in a series, each depicting different interactions between individuals. The first scene shows a group gathered around a table outdoors, the second scene features a trio outdoors, and the third scene depicts a conversation between two figures in a natural setting. The drawing consists of three individual panels placed in a horizontal sequence.

In the first panel, a figure stands, gesturing towards others who are seated around the table, surrounded by trees and foliage.

The middle panel depicts three figures dressed in period costume, with one figure at the center holding the hand of another. The background suggests a garden or courtyard setting.

In the third panel, a figure dressed in flowing robes gestures towards another figure seated on a stone bench beneath a large tree. Rich foliage and distant architecture complete the scene. The drawings are intricate and detailed, capturing the atmosphere of each setting.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Hutin, after Jean François de Troy
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two figures with detailed depictions of their full bodies. On the left, a person is kneeling with their upper body leaning forward. They have delicate facial features with long, dark hair pulled back, wearing a long, flowing robe. Beside them is a woven basket with cloth draping out. Nearby, a fireplace with burning logs and a shelf holding dishes and a pitcher are visible, along with a cloth draped over the ledge. To the right, another figure with wings appears to be in motion, stepping lightly with their body angled towards the other person. They have an expressive look on their face, short wavy hair, and wear a draped garment leaving one shoulder bare. In their hand, they hold a branch with flowers. Above them, a dove is depicted with light rays streaming downwards. The room's background includes stone textures, arched niches, and wood floors.

artworks.title: The Weaver's Cottage
artworks.medium: pastel, conté crayon, and charcoal on tan paper, mounted on canvas (on wooden stretcher)
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 38.3 × 48.5 cm (15 1/16 × 19 1/8 in.) (approximate dimensions, measured in housing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Merritt Porter Dyke in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene in a weaving workshop. The image features a dimly lit room with two large windows providing scattered daylight. In the foreground, a wooden spinning wheel is depicted, with a person seated at it. The background shows a large loom stretching across the room. The wooden beams and rough-hewn furniture give the room an authentic, rustic charm.

artworks.title: Une Matinée d'autommne (Autumn Afternoon)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and drypoint on chinese paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a ground-level perspective. The horizon line is low, merging with the sky. Slender trees with sparse foliage rise vertically along the horizon. The brushstrokes are delicate and fine. A figure with a dog wades through shallow water. In the background, the landscape extends into a wooded area. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and beige, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Rape of Proserpina
artworks.medium: woodcut and wood engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 45.6 × 35 cm (17 15/16 × 13 3/4 in.), cut to image
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot pulled by horses driven by a figure holding a trident. The drawing depicts a detailed scene where a figure is driving a chariot drawn by two horses. The chariot is shown in motion, with one wheel visible, accentuated by ribbons. Stylized clouds surround the scene in the sky. The drawing displays intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Alzata dell'Obelisco di Campo Marzio (Excavation of the Obelisk from the Campo Marzio)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: The image depicts an ancient architectural scene with various structures and activities. In the center, a large obelisk is being erected with wooden beams and ropes. To the left are engraved stone blocks. In the background, there is a building with open windows. On the right, a crowd is gathered, observing the scene. The artwork is detailed, showing texture and age through intricate lines. The monochromatic palette emphasizes form and texture. The composition is structured yet dynamic, showcasing both the static structures and construction activity.

artworks.title: Le Marchand de dessins lithographiques (The Lithograph Seller)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a small, open-air art shop or kiosk displaying sketches. The image depicts an outdoor scene where several individuals are examining artwork that is put up on the walls of a small structure. The structure appears makeshift, with a slanted roof, and it is filled with artworks displayed prominently for viewing. There are stacks of paper or books on the counter. The individuals present are engaged in observing these artworks. The scene is detailed, capturing textures of clothing and the woodwork of the structure, along with subtle shadows and highlights giving an almost lifelike, three-dimensional appearance.

artworks.title: Délassement champêtre (Sylvan Leisure)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with figures reclining amidst trees and a rocky landscape. The drawing depicts several figures lounging in a natural setting, with some of them possibly engaged in playing musical instruments or in conversation. The setting is serene and pastoral, featuring stylized trees and an outdoor area that suggests leisure and relaxation. In the background, a rocky landscape can be seen, adding depth to the scene. The figures are draped in flowing garments, contributing to the classical ambiance of the composition. The title "DÉLASSEMENT CHAMPÊTRE" at the bottom suggests a theme of rural relaxation or pastoral enjoyment. The use of lines and shading gives the drawing a textured and detailed appearance.

artworks.title: L’Amour terrassant un lion (Personification of Love Vanquishing a Lion)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length figure in a semi-kneeling position. The person is leaning forward, resting their left leg on a stone, and beginning to rise. Their right arm is bent holding a bow, while their left arm is extended downward, touching a lion. The person has curly hair and classical features, with wings behind them. They also have a draped cloth at their waist and a quiver of arrows slung across their shoulder. The background shows detailed rock formations, creating an ancient or mythological setting.

artworks.title: Carnevale
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an individual standing upright. The person has distinct facial features, a beard, and a mustache. They are wearing a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, a fur-lined overcoat with fur trim, and a ruffled collar. The individual's right hand is raised, and their left hand is placed on a cloth covering an object. To the left is a grand armchair. The background features simple line drawings suggesting a room with possible windows or curtains.

artworks.title: Frédéric Sauvage
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of an older man standing in a room. He has his arms crossed over his chest and is looking slightly to his left. The man has a beard, a moustache, full hair, and is wearing a long coat or robe with shoes. There are various objects around him, including a chair, papers with geometric drawings, an easel, and a bust sculpture. The background includes a window overlooking a landscape with greenery and hills. The room is filled with books, diagrams, and busts on shelves.

artworks.title: Interior of St. Peter’s, with the Illumination of the Cross of St. Peter
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of National Gallery of Art staff in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the interior of a church or cathedral. It features a large, intricately designed religious space with a soaring dome, ornate columns, and detailed ceiling motifs. In the foreground, there is a structure resembling an altar or central canopy with twisted columns, adorned with intricate carvings and ornamental features. The background shows tall walls rising up to the elaborate ceiling, filled with geometric designs and panels. Light enters through windows high above, illuminating a central area with a large cross. The drawing captures the monumental scale and architectural detail of historical ecclesiastical buildings, providing a view into the church interior.

artworks.title: Venise sauvée (Venice Preserved)
artworks.medium: lithograph on laid paper (proof before letters)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and shapes creating movement and energy. The lines resemble flames or waves around two figures with elongated faces, reminiscent of classical sculptures. Above these faces are swirling patterns suggesting hair or smoke. In the lower portion, a shadowy face with an intense gaze emerges from swirling patterns resembling mist or water. Beside the main design is a vertical column of small mask-like faces, each with distinct features. The scene is framed with decorative floral patterns and abstract shapes, evoking a sense of theatrical grandeur.

artworks.title: Milchwagen (Milk Wagon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jutta Mosse, in memory of Edith Steinfeld
artworks.description: The image features a horse-drawn carriage in the foreground, with textured brushstrokes creating a rich tapestry effect. In the distance, a building's roofline forms a subtle horizon between the ground and the sky. The artwork utilizes a monochromatic color scheme of black and white, emphasizing details and form. Trees frame the carriage on either side, their bare branches suggesting a season like early spring or autumn. The composition conveys a sense of movement and depth through light and dark areas produced by cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Prince with a Ruby
artworks.medium: watercolor, gold and ink on paper, with edge strips, mounted on paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet approximately: 18.73 × 9.21 cm (7 3/8 × 3 5/8 in.)
mount: 35.56 × 23.18 cm (14 × 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jutta Mosse, in memory of Rudolf Mosse
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing in profile facing left. He has a beard, mustache, and styled black hair under a turban with a feather. He wears traditional attire with a golden robe over a pink garment adorned with intricate patterns. He holds a sword in his left hand and a jewel or decorative item in his right hand. The background is light green, with a decorative frame.

artworks.title: A Couple on a Terrace Surrounded by Attendants and Musicians
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold on paper mounted on paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jutta Mosse, in memory of Rudolf Mosse

artworks.title: Scranton Terminus, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated perspective of an industrial scene with various buildings, trees along the horizon, railcars on multiple tracks, and a rocky, uneven ground with scattered stones and dirt. The color palette is monochrome, typical of early photography.

artworks.title: Eaton and Co.'s Breaker, Archibald, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene with a factory complex on a sloped terrain. A line of trees marks the horizon, with residential-style buildings clustered below the industrial structures. The sepia-toned image has detailed brushstrokes capturing the texture of the surroundings.

artworks.title: Olyphant, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund

artworks.title: Gibson's Breaker, Rushdale, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene with a complex of wooden buildings and structures. There is a line of trees along the horizon. The background has a moderate forest. The image appears to be an old photograph in sepia tone, capturing the structures in detail. Rocks and debris are in the foreground, with buildings and towers in the background.

artworks.title: Grassy Island Shaft, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a small industrial building complex in a rural landscape. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down at the structure with a chimney. A line of trees obscures the horizon, with hills fading into the mist in the distance. The terrain is sloped with grass, rocks, and tree stumps. The color palette is monochrome sepia, and there are no visible brushstrokes, suggesting it is a photograph.

artworks.title: Carbondale, Section 3, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an overhead view of a small town in a valley. There is a horizon near the top of the image with sparse trees on a cleared hillside. The town is dense with various buildings, including prominent structures like churches on the left and right. The buildings have pitched roofs and are mainly residential, with narrow and orderly streets between them. The scene extends into the distance, showing the town spread across the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving the image a historical and nostalgic feel.

artworks.title: Birdsey Breaker, Archbald, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a settlement from a slightly elevated perspective. In the foreground are wooden houses and small structures arranged neatly along dirt paths. In the background, there is a large industrial structure with steam rising from it. Towards the horizon, there is a line of dense trees against the sky. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones, giving the scene an aged look. The overall landscape includes industrial facilities, wooded hills, outbuildings, and stacks of supplies. The depiction, whether a painting or a photograph, conveys precise and detailed brushstrokes capturing industrial and residential elements.

artworks.title: Archbald, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a town from an elevated perspective. A river cuts through the landscape. An industrial structure with tracks leading to it can be seen, with smoke coming from a chimney. The town has various buildings with light-colored roofs. The color palette is earthy with browns and grays. Sunlight filters through, potentially giving a sepia tone to the scene.
